_meta.title: BEN Engine contract template field vocabulary
_meta.generated_from: docs/contracts/*.md (excluding README.md) by scanning [A-Z_0-9] bracket tokens
_meta.convention: Every template token is [FIELD_NAME]; the proposal generator substitutes all tokens; a document is ready for signature only when no [A-Z...] token remains

sources.schedule: docs/PROCESS_FLOW.md durations applied to the order date
sources.counsel: set once with counsel; default shown is a starting point, not advice
sources.default: standard value used in the templates

_meta.rule: SUPPLIER_LD_GRACE_DAYS <= CM_LD_GRACE_DAYS <= LD_GRACE_DAYS so upstream LDs accrue before downstream LDs
